Bobby Bloom's "Montego Bay" reached #8 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Montego Bay" is a song co-written and performed by Bobby Bloom about the city in Jamaica of the same name.

The song was a top ten hit for Bloom in the Fall of 1970 on both sides of the Atlantic.

The song peaked at #8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

Montego Bay was released in 1970.
